Container.Name: bowel
Container.Overview: bowel without a window: a mihomo (Clash Meta) proxy for the LAN, with routes, a terminal interface and MCP for agents. Point programs at http://[server]:7899 (HTTP and SOCKS5 on one port). The interface is "docker exec -it bowel bowel tui" in Unraid's terminal; the image has no shell, so Console opens nothing.

Config.Name: Proxy port
Config.Description: HTTP and SOCKS5 on one port.

Config.Name: Subscription
Config.Description: Subscription URLs or node links, separated by commas. Each that no Provider has yet is added when the container starts.

Config.Name: Allowed clients
Config.Description: Who may use the proxy, as CIDRs separated by commas. Empty leaves the setting as it is, which starts as private addresses.
